limits: Each fresh run watches one CPU range, not all ranges simultaneously.
The moving watch covers only execution after the accepted 21st rightward movement commit; earlier route activity is not watched.
The route prefix uses named source anchors; a three-second wall-bounded no-hit window has variable emulated duration.
No-hit is not observed within this route/window, never proof of unused memory.
CPU mmio data-access events do not establish instruction-fetch or DMA coverage.
Original direct-payload execution, not original disk/loader parity, full playthrough or candidate equivalence.
Full register/stack/RAM captures and generated media remain private.
No source annotation or classification change is accepted merely from a watch hit.
Registers are paused-state snapshots, not asserted pre-access registers; accessing PC and paused PC are separately byte-matched.
